name: 99 Nights in the Forest Block Run
desc:
Play 99 Nights in the Forest Block Race with your friends!

How to play:
1. Run to the finish without falling!
2. Stand on the right Color Block before the time runs out!
3. Get to the end to win a point!

⭐ Roblox Premium players get +10% speed and daily rewards!
🎁 Join our community "Tuff Games" to get special group rewards

👍 Like the game if you're having fun!
🕹️ VIP Servers are free. Play by yourself or with friends!
💬 Tell us what you think or report bugs on our community wall!
